summary.headline: Zacharias on Astrological Book Burning
summary.text: A testimony from Zacharias Scholasticus’s Life of Severus of Antioch describes Christian destruction of magical and astrological books at Berytus around 487–488. The burned works were attributed to John of Thebes, Zoroaster, Ostanes, Manetho, George of Thessalonica, and Asclepiodotus of Heliopolis.
